note: Emulator under software GL. Absolute durations are far worse than a real device; the sequence and the ordering defects are what these establish. Cold-launch timing, before vs after, is in launch-timing.json.

phases.cause: AppTheme sets android:windowDisablePreview=true, so there is no starting window and no platform splash

phases.onScreen: single-frame hard cut from launcher to the splash artwork
phases.evidence: 60fps frame extraction; no icon frame, no windowSplashScreenBackground, no exit animation

phases.gate: PlaylistsState.READY from refreshPlaylists(); network-bound, no fixed timer

phases.onScreen: splash artwork with the FINAL bottom navigation bar drawn on top of it
phases.defect: MainFragment.onResume() sets bottomNavView VISIBLE when the transaction commits, while the 250ms splash fade-out is still running and HOME has not drawn

phases.onScreen: HOME, playlist cards still empty placeholders

runs.cause: the navigation action pops the splash inclusively (popUpTo=splashFragment, popUpToInclusive=true)

runs.method: adb root, kill -9 pidof; pid 4624 -> 5081 confirms death; then am start
runs.result: HOME restored directly, navigation state survives past the splash
runs.note: am kill alone is a no-op here: the bound MediaPlayerService holds the process up

phases.onScreen: pre-12 scale-up of the app window over a black surround
drawable-nodpi/screenN, centerCrop, full bleed, status bar visible
splash artwork with the bottom navigation bar on top

corrections.note: Two owner corrections after the first visual review. The runs in `after` below were re-measured with both applied.

splashMark.was: @drawable/ic_launcher_foreground - carried the yellow radial-gradient launcher plate, filled 63.5% of its viewport, rendered 184x184dp
splashMark.now: @drawable/ic_splash_mark - the same mark geometry with the plate and its white sheen removed, inset to 31% of the viewport
splashMark.centred: within half a pixel of the screen centre on every run
splashMark.howSizeIsControlled: The framework maps the 108 viewport onto the splash icon box, measured ~290dp on both API levels, so apparent size is the fraction of the viewport the art occupies - the adaptive-icon contract, not a hardcoded density.

bottomNavGate.was: revealed on the splash fragment's onFragmentViewDestroyed
bottomNavGate.wasWrongBecause: measured: HOME draws at alpha 1.0 immediately, but the splash's view lingered ~815ms behind it, invisible and occluded. The bar therefore arrived 0.45-0.8s after HOME.
bottomNavGate.now: revealed from an OnPreDrawListener on HOME's root, in the first traversal where it is laid out and opaque
bottomNavGate.safeBecause: HOME's root fills the window and paints @color/background, so once it draws opaque the splash behind it contributes no pixels
bottomNavGate.measured: the bar is present in HOME's very first frame at 60fps on both API levels; no HOME frame without it

after.change: Theme.Myata.Splash as the activity's manifest theme, core-splashscreen, a mark-only splash drawable, and the bottom bar gated on HOME's first opaque frame

phases.onScreen: standard Android 12+ splash enter transition, launcher cross-dissolving into the splash; no black or white frame at 60fps
drawable-nodpi/screenN, unchanged, with no bottom navigation bar on it
HOME; the bottom navigation bar appears with it, not before it

runs.note: same mark, dark background - the semantic role resolves per configuration, so Dark needed no second resource

runs.observed: POST_NOTIFICATIONS dialog appears over the app's own artwork

runs.result: returns directly to the destination it was on
starting window in @color/background, then the restored destination
runs.note: The platform draws the splash icon for a cold start; a relaunch into a process the MediaPlayerService has already restarted gets the flat background window instead. Either way the launcher is gone immediately, which is what the ~6.8s before this was.

runs.result: app returns to PLAYER with the control showing Pause - the session is reattached, not restarted

phases.onScreen: app mark centred on @color/background, drawn before the app has run
drawable-nodpi/screenN, unchanged, with no bottom navigation bar on it
HOME; the bottom navigation bar appears with it

runs.result: returns directly to HOME, unchanged from before the fix

assertions: the bar is not granted to HOME while the splash still has a view
HOME's first presented frame already carries the bar
the live theme does not carry windowDisablePreview

after.darkModeOnApi24: Not applicable: Android 7.0 has no system dark mode ('cmd uimode' is not implemented), so the starting window there is always the light @color/background.

artworkGeometry.note: Crop depends on the window aspect ratio, not on dp width, so it is identical at 320/360/390/412dp for a given aspect. Unchanged by the fix - the artwork was left alone.

after.translucencyNote: windowIsTranslucent is left declared on AppTheme but is now inert: the system reads translucency from the manifest theme, and a setTheme() after the window exists cannot make an opaque window translucent.
